purpose: Actual input-to-full-product caller using fifteen-point interpolation and recomposition. Existing Toom4 children are retained.
domain: balanced accepts full-u64 7*k<=n<=8*k including empty; full accepts positive equal lengths and outer threshold>=56, child Toom4 threshold>=24.
workspace: balanced uses caller scratch>=44*(k+1); full uses>=12*n; arithmetic proof establishes 44*m<=12*n for n>56. This is actual slice capacity, not recursive Toom8 lifetime closure.
caller_boundary: No supplied numeric coefficients: actual interpolation establishes every recomposition coefficient premise from input blocks.
analytic_cost: One Toom8 split over existing Toom4 children: T4(k)+T4(h)+13*T4(k+1)+O(n). Not yet recursive Toom8 nor a checked machine-cost theorem.
